result.summary: This PR replaces contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh with a Python script (check-deps.py) that parses the mermaid dependency graph in doc/design/libraries.md as the single source of truth for allowed inter-library symbol dependencies, automatically computing transitive closures instead of requiring them to be hand-listed. It also demangles C++ symbol names in error output, fixes a bug where the old script silently reported false success on macOS, and includes a commit moving init/common.cpp from libbitcoin_common to libbitcoin_node plus doc updates simplifying the dependency graph.
result.problem: The old shell script required manually enumerating every transitive dependency and had a silent false-success bug on macOS (confirmed by janb84's testing), making the dependency check unreliable and tedious to maintain as libraries.md drifted from the enforced rules.
